Heartwood_Timber_Core.description: An immensely heavy, solid chassis composed of ancient, ultra-dense heartwood. Utterly lacking a distinct skeletal structure, the entire core acts as both support and muscle, providing terrifying durability but abysmal maneuverability.

Pliant_Vine_Matrix.description: A body composed entirely of thousands of overlapping, prehensile vines woven into a humanoid shape. It can instantly dramatically flatten itself or slip entirely through incredibly narrow grates by briefly un-weaving its core structure.
